note_en: The family motto 该省的省，该花的花 uses 该 + verb + 的 to mean "what ought to be V-ed" and then repeats the verb: "save what should be saved, spend what should be spent." Chinese builds the rule just by echoing the verb, with no "what" or "when" needed; the text plays with it all the way through, down to 该聚的聚，该买的买 "get together with whoever you should, buy whatever you should."
